title: Teamwork Lights the Way

dialogue.speaker: marlow
dialogue.text: I hear glimmer lights, let’s gather them gently together now!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Be careful, Marlow, the lights love quiet teamwork always.

dialogue.speaker: marlow
dialogue.text: I’ll place each spark where the map shows eastward direction!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Now the pattern shines clearly, thanks to our helpful teamwork!

dialogue.speaker: marlow
dialogue.text: Our friendship makes the glimmer brighter for everyone watching!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Let’s celebrate with a snack by the pond later together!
